src/agent_runtime/accounts/runtime.py

Python · Tier A

Route authenticated work to independently owned Controller applications.

Details

The migrated workspace retains its original storage paths. Installation services and each account own independently checkpointed repository graphs. Gateway rows in those graphs are projections; the installation registry and live account authority are always rechecked before dispatch.
